notes.title: Phantom Relics – Update 1.1.0.0 is Live!
notes.notes:
Greetings, adventurers!

We’ve just released a new update for Phantom Relics focused on polishing the gameplay experience, squashing some lingering bugs, and improving overall immersion.

Here’s what’s new in version 1.1.0.0:

 🛠 Fixed issues that prevented some Steam achievements from unlocking correctly
 🎧 Adjusted volume levels for certain sound effects
 💥 Added several new sound and visual effects to enhance combat feedback
 ⚔️ Made balance adjustments to combat encounters
 🧠 Tweaked the behavior of certain enemy AI patterns
 🗺 Minor visual and layout improvements in selected locations
 🌍 Improved localization quality across all supported languages
 🐞 Various bug fixes and under-the-hood improvements
 📜 Updated some in-game item descriptions for clarity
 🎮 Improved responsiveness of certain input actions during combat
 🔦 Enhanced lighting effects in a few darker areas to improve visibility

We hope these changes make your next dungeon run even smoother and more atmospheric.
As always, thank you for playing and supporting Phantom Relics. Your feedback keeps the torch burning!
